prompt: Mid-century theatrical cartoon still promotional Hollywood movie trailer banner for The End of Oak Street, featuring a caricature of Ewan McGregor as the determined father with neatly combed dark hair and a protective expression, wearing a classic plaid shirt and trousers, and a caricature of Anne Hathaway as the resourceful mother with soft brunette waves and steady eyes, wearing a practical blouse and cardigan, seated together on a suburban porch that has suddenly shifted into an otherworldly landscape. Stage them in a lighthearted, good-humored interaction, with both characters fully visible, relaxed, and clearly reacting to each other as they face the strange new world. Design the figures with exaggerated early-1950s animation caricature: clean black contour lines, sharply simplified anatomy, elegant angular silhouettes, expressive eyebrows, stylized facial shapes, graceful hand gestures, and cheerful readable expressions. Render the entire image in a unified traditional cel-animation aesthetic, with the background following the same stylized visual language as the characters, using flat opaque colors, minimal hard-edged shading, simplified furniture and décor, subtle hand-painted texture, controlled perspective, and crisp theatrical staging. Use a mysterious adventure palette of soft teal, warm cream, dusty green, and gentle gold and maintain a witty, charming, visually snappy mood.

promptZh: 20 世纪中叶影院卡通剧照风格的电影预告片宣传横幅，主题为 The End of Oak Street。画面中包含 Ewan McGregor 的漫画形象，饰演一位神情坚定的父亲，梳着整齐的深色头发，表情充满保护欲，身穿经典格纹衬衫和长裤；以及 Anne Hathaway 的漫画形象，饰演一位足智多谋的母亲，留着柔和的棕色波浪卷发，眼神沉稳，身穿实用的衬衫和开衫。两人并肩坐在郊区的门廊上，而门廊已突然转变为超现实的景观。将他们置于一种轻松幽默的互动场景中，两个角色全身可见，姿态放松，在面对这个奇异新世界时有着明显的互动反应。人物设计采用 20 世纪 50 年代初夸张的动画漫画风格：清晰的黑色轮廓线、高度简化的解剖结构、优雅的棱角剪影、富有表现力的眉毛、风格化的面部形状、优美的手势以及欢快易读的表情。整幅图像采用统一的传统赛璐珞动画美学进行渲染，背景与人物遵循相同的风格化视觉语言，使用平涂的不透明色彩、极简的硬边阴影、简化的家具和装饰、细腻的手绘质感、受控的透视以及清晰的影院式构图。使用 柔和青色、暖奶油色、灰绿色和柔和金色的神秘冒险配色方案，并保持一种风趣、迷人且视觉效果鲜明的氛围。
